title: Fined for not wearing a seat belt
triggers: fined because passenger not wearing seatbelt

rights.plain_explanation: Driving without a seat belt, or carrying passengers who aren't wearing one, is fined ₹1,000.

do_now: Accept the challan; this one is lawful.
Ask for the official e-challan or a receipt.
user_at_fault_cases: Driving or carrying passengers without seat belts is against the law, so the ₹1,000 fine is legal.

escalation.label: Pay the challan officially
escalation.detail: Pay on the Virtual Courts portal or the method on the challan.
